item.title: The Deepwave devlog is live
item.description: A place for the technical write-ups and build notes behind Deepwave's Unity tools and analog-horror games.
item.content:encoded:
This is where the longer write-ups go — the parts of building a tool that do not fit in a store description or a changelog line.

Coming up:

  • How the RetroOS browser renders real HTML and CSS inside Unity's UI system — the parser, the CSS cascade, and hit-testing a link in the middle of a wrapped paragraph.
  • Reading where a cobweb attaches straight out of the texture's alpha channel — why the artwork already knows where the web is tied, and how Cobweb Weaver turns that into a placement algorithm.
  • Writing an FBX file from Unity without the FBX Exporter package — because the format has no four-component UV, and a cobweb vertex carries four.

If you want to be told when these land, the tools index links every package's docs and store page.
